title: Kimi K3.1 Pro - open model jo top AI ko takkar de raha hai
content:
Ek open model aaya hai jo duniya ke sabse strong closed models ko takkar de raha hai.
Naam hai Kimi K3.1 Pro. China ki company Moonshot AI ne launch kiya hai.
Moonshot ke hisaab se ye unka sabse capable open-weight model hai.
Total two point eight trillion parameters, aur ek baar mein one hundred four billion active.
Context window, one million tokens. Matlab ek poori codebase ya kai lambi reports ek saath.
Ab numbers dekho.
Terminal-Bench four point zero pe, jo coding agents ko real terminal tasks pe test karta hai, K3.1 Pro ne SIXTY FIVE POINT SEVEN PERCENT score kiya.
GPT-6 Astra ka fifty eight point two. Aur Claude Opus five point five ka sixty six point four.
Yaani almost top ke barabar. One caution: these are Moonshot's own reported numbers.
Aur sabse badi baat?
Moonshot ne kaha hai ki full model weights FOUR NOVEMBER tak release honge.
Matlab koi bhi company isse download karke apne servers pe chala sakti hai.
Right now, the weights are not out yet. Abhi ye app aur API pe available hai.
Aap pooch sakte ho, mujhe isse kya?
Jab open model itna strong ho jaata hai, toh aapke paas choice aa jaati hai.
Aapko apna data kisi ek company ko bhejna zaroori nahi.
Toh use kaise karein?
Step one. kimi.ai pe jaake try karo. Apna ek real task do, jaise ek lamba PDF summarize karna.
Step two. Agar aap developer ho, toh Kimi API pe kimi-k3.1-pro select karo aur apne current model se compare karo.
Step three. Same prompt, dono models. Quality, speed aur cost note karo.
Maan lo aapka ek customer support bot hai. Agar ye model sasta aur utna hi accha nikla, toh aapka bill seedha kam ho sakta hai.
Mera take simple hai.
Open aur closed models ka gap ab bahut chhota ho raha hai. NEVER LOCK YOURSELF into one provider.
Apna code aisa rakho ki model badalna ek line ka kaam ho.
Comment KIMI and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
